INSEAD in the Middle East

Welcome to INSEAD in Abu Dhabi

Drawing on over 50 years of experience at the leading edge of business education and research in Europe and Asia, in 2007 INSEAD strengthened its presence in the Middle East with a campus in Abu Dhabi.

Located in ADGM Square on Al Maryah Island, INSEAD Middle East Campus bridges Western, Asian and Middle Eastern markets. We are committed to developing business education and bringing advanced managerial ideas and worldwide business practices to the region.

“INSEAD’s nearly 20-year presence in Abu Dhabi has been integral to our global mission, and our commitment to the region is stronger than ever.”

A Campus at the Crossroads

Set midway between INSEAD’s Europe and Asia Campuses, the Middle East Campus provides access to Abu Dhabi’s premier financial district and the markets of the Gulf and wider MENA region.

Engage with local and international corporations, government entities and diversifying industries including finance, technology and sustainable development.

Middle East Campus Information →

Facilities in INSEAD Middle East Campus

The campus occupies the 29th and 30th floors of Al Khatem Tower in ADGM Square on Al Maryah Island, in the heart of Abu Dhabi’s financial district.

Explore our teaching spaces and immersive learning environment. Access essential details including directions, operating hours, transport, accommodation and accessibility.
